cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(slambench_orbslam3_driver CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 14)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "-O3 -march=x86-64")

set(ORBSLAM3_ROOT "/opt/ORB_SLAM3" CACHE PATH "ORB-SLAM3 source/build root")
find_package(OpenCV 4.2 REQUIRED)
find_package(Eigen3 3.1.0 REQUIRED)
find_package(Pangolin REQUIRED)

add_executable(orbslam3_driver slambench_driver.cc)
target_include_directories(orbslam3_driver PRIVATE
    ${ORBSLAM3_ROOT}
    ${ORBSLAM3_ROOT}/include
    ${ORBSLAM3_ROOT}/include/CameraModels
    ${ORBSLAM3_ROOT}/Thirdparty/Sophus
    ${EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIR}
    ${Pangolin_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(orbslam3_driver
    ${ORBSLAM3_ROOT}/lib/libORB_SLAM3.so
    ${ORBSLAM3_ROOT}/Thirdparty/DBoW2/lib/libDBoW2.so
    ${ORBSLAM3_ROOT}/Thirdparty/g2o/lib/libg2o.so
    ${OpenCV_LIBS} ${Pangolin_LIBRARIES} -lboost_serialization -lcrypto pthread)

add_executable(slambench_preprocess_check slambench_preprocess_check.cc)
target_link_libraries(slambench_preprocess_check ${OpenCV_LIBS})
